notes.title: Bots Have Arrived!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33198949/8bd029f92f3c95d22376bba98eab9a72bd4e1fb9.png
The Droids Are Coming!
Bots are here! That's right folks, we've got an update for all ya'lls that can fill the world with bots and a bunch o'weapon changes for ya and all those other cool lil' fixes that makes you want to yell less at your computer and the people around you.

So let's get straight to it and see what's changed!

Changelog 0.3.1.0
Added

Added bots!
 Added option to reduce Fog of War resolution in order to make the game more playable on lower end GPUs

Balance

Reworked Atomizer
Is now a plasma shotgun
Fires 5 projectiles per shot in a 16° cone
Fire rate reduced to 0.9s (from 0.125s)
Starting ammo is reduced to 6 (from 20)
Max ammo is reduced to 12 (from 120)
 Does no longer need to reload


Combined Snubnose and Six Shooter into the Revolver
40 damage (from 50 Snubnose, 60 Six Shooter)
0.6s fire rate (from 0.5s Snubnose, 0.7s Six Shooter)
2° spread (from 6° Snubnose, 0° Six Shooter)
1.5s reload time (from 1.5s Snubnose, 2.8s Six Shooter)


Replaced Machine Pistol with Pocket Pistol
Reduced clip size to 8 (from 20)
Reduced max ammo to 32 (from 120)
Decreased fire rate to 0.2s per shot (from 0.05s)
Decreased spread to 3° (from 20°)
Removed recoil
Increased damage to 20 (from 16)
Removed damage fall-off


Replaced Blitzkrieg with Patriot
Reduced clip size to 20 (from 32)
Reduced max ammo to 80 (from 128)
Decreased spread to 2° (from 20°)
Increased base spread to 2° (from 0°)
Removed recoil
Added 35% slow while firing


Rebalanced Boomstick
Updated model
Decreased spread to 10° (from 15°)
Decreased pellet deviation to 3° (from 5°)
Increased max distance damage to 35% (from 20%)


Renamed Cleaver to Chopstick
Increased walk movement speed to 70% (from 60%)
Raiden Coil shots now pierces players dealing full damage to all hit players
Changed equip time to 0.5s for all weapons
Changed item movement speed modifiers
Katana & Raiden Coil unchanged
Increased Chopstick movement speed to 115% (from 110%)
Changed movement speed to 98% for all other items


Changes

Fog of War shadow map resolution will now dynamically change depending on how many active observers there currently are in order to improve performance
General performance improvements
Incompatible dedicated servers will no longer show up in the server browser
Removed death icons from minimap
Weapons that doesn’t need reloading now show ammo on crosshair
Moved second Tokyo server to Sydney (What's up Australia we think you're really cool and hope you think we're cool too)


Fixes

Fixed dedicated servers sometimes reporting incorrect player count
Fixed eternal eating bug when joining while a remote player is eating
Fixed damage numbers lingering on screen if a player disconnects while being spectated
Fixed color being incorrect on some blood particle systems
Fixed potential RNG desync on dedicated servers
Fixed weapon sometimes being offset incorrectly from the character model when picked up
Fixed hair cosmetics sometimes showing up in Fog of War without the character model
Added audio zone fallback in order to prevent gunfire reflection layers from being played incorrectly
Increased audio polyphony in order to prevent sounds from dropping when there’s a lot of gun fire


Well that's about it for this round of updates folks! Remember to verify the integrity of your files and yell at us if you run into any problems with anything!

notes.title: Dedicated Servers are here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33198949/26704557e002dfc42265762772a369a004476a99.png
Dedicated Servers Have Arrived!
Dust off that keyboard because the dedicated servers are finally here! Now you can just hop into an area of your choice, check out your ping to different countries, and tell Australia that they're pretty cool people (looking at you Jeay).

That's right folks. We've got Dedicated Servers available in the following areas


Added central EU server (Frankfurt)
Added eastern US server (Virginia)
Added western US server (Oregon)
Added two Japan servers (Tokyo)


Peer-to-Peer is still available for those who would like to host their own servers, or create private games with their friends. Now on to the change log!

Changelog 0.3.0.0

Added

Added votekick for dedicated servers
Votekicked players will be temporarily banned for 5 minutes
Added spam filter for ingame chat
Added sliders in the options menu to control crosshair size
Added new fancy hairstyle


Changes

Hostile Work Environment
Added an extra player spawn to support 16 players
Changed the consumable spawn point in the bar area to an item spawn point
Tweaked lighting on both levels
Increased player cap to 16
Default for lobbies is still 12, but can be changed in the create game menu


Fixes

 Fixed Royale With Cheese sometimes disappearing when activated
Fixed bug where windows would break locally if an enemy is shot in front of a window
Fixed stutter when walking through doors on some systems
Fixed issue where the game would slowly allocate unnecessary memory over a long period of time
Weapons should now always autoreload when the last shot in the current clip was fired and reserve ammo is available



That's it for the updates this time around folks! Feel free to wave your arms around at us with any questions, ideas, or suggestions on our Discord!

Remember to verify the integrity of your files!

And that content update is fantastic! More blood, more explosions! More way to end your friendships for all eternity with some new weapons and a bunch load of balance changes to make stuff even cooler!

o͡͡͡╮༼ ಠДಠ ༽╭o͡͡͡━☆ﾟ.*･｡ﾟ

☆ SirSlaughter (who LOVES banana pizza)

こんにちは it's us again
A Wild PATCH has appeared!
o FIGHT
o ITEM
o RUN
o READ

Hey folks! We're here to present to you a few fixes! And some nice optimization which some of you have been all jazzed about. But the most important thing we have going on is our BRAND NEW ROADMAP!

As a note, the price of the game will increase each time that we complete a Milestone. However, if you own the game you will not need to pay more, and all Milestone features are added to your game free of charge. We thank you folks so much for being with us while we're in Early Access and your feedback has been fantastic!

There are also a few things we got planned that will be like fun little surprises. You can ask us about it but I'll probably be really vague and then panic because I can't keep a secret to save my life.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33198949/976ab5f0ccb442a9187ab550ee56b74deafa7bff.png

Balance
Reduced Boomstick overall spread to 15° (from 18°) and individual pellet spread to 5° (from 6°)

notes.title: Gigantic Content Update: New Map, New Weapons, かっこいい!
notes.content:

September 4th 素晴らしいです Content Update
Hey folks! We have a lot of great stuff coming your way! This is the first BIG patch that we're unraveling here! You've been asking us for things, and we've been here to listen!

But first off, let's list our Players Of The Week based on my total bias! This week includes
♡ Kuma
♡ Tamagonn
♡ Russ 914
♡ Archampion
♡ PulsT.C

Updated Summary
For people who are like me and their eyes glaze over reading patch notes, the update includes:

♡ New Map - Hostile Work Environment
♡ New Weapons - Blitzkreig, Breacher, Boomstick
♡ Weapon rebalances
♡ Brand hecking new lighting
♡ Dodge roll through windows
♡ Polish & bug fixes

Want to read the full patch notes? Scroll down and you'll see everything we've changed! Remember, If you were on the beta branch, please opt out of the beta branch and verify the integrity of your files
Steamをオープンして、ファイルの整合性を検証してください

So What's Next?
As always, if there's any ideas you folks have, let us know on our Discord! We are here to listen to you, and create this game with you guys in mind. 

We'll be providing a visual roadmap soon so you folks have a better idea of where we are, and where we want to be. Now, on to the massive pile of patch notes!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33198949/56e3e146a70e315448499415fc3c569f6215e49d.png

Added
New level: Hostile Work Environment
Dodge rolling into windows will now shatter them
Dodge rolling will now be available for a short window after walking off an edge
Added additional loading info to the loading screen

Balance
Replaced Patriot with Blitzkrieg
Now fully automatic with a fire rate of 1 shot every 0.075s (patriot fired 3-round bursts over 0.2s every 0.9s)
Decreased reload time to 1.8s (from 3s)
Decreased damage to 12 (from 25)
Increased movement speed to 108% (from 82%)
Increased base spread to 5° (from 2°)
Removed recoil (patriot had up to 8° regular recoil)
Max ammo set at 128 (prev. 150)
Renamed Pump Shotgun to Breacher
Updated model to a shorter shotgun with pistol stock
Reload speed is now 0.5s per shell (first shell previously took 1s)
Faster fire rate at 0.8s (from 0.9s)
Decreased damage per pellet to 12 (from 15)
Increased damage fall off at max range to 65% (from 50%)
Reduced overall spread to 12° (from 15°) and individual pellet spread to 3° (from 4°)
Renamed Super Shotgun to Boomstick
Now fires both barrels independently (rather than both at once)
Now has to reload which takes 1.6s
Faster fire rate at 0.35s (from 1.6s)
Decreased pellets per shot to 8 (from 16)
Increased damage per pellet to 15 (from 12)
Increased damage fall off at max range to 65% (from 50%)
Reduced overall spread to 18° (from 24°) and reduced individual pellet spread to 6° (from 8°)
Starting ammo set at 4 (up from 3)
Max ammo set at 8 (prev. 12)
Individual hit slow amount and duration per weapon
Splash damage and Flare Gun flares no longer inflict slow
Boomstick & Breacher inflicts 15% slow for 1s (per pellet)
Cleaver inflicts 20% slow for 1s
Blitzkrieg inflicts 25% slow for 0.75s (per shot)
Katana inflicts 30% slow for 1s
Buzzkill inflicts 35% slow for 1s (per bounce)

Hand Cannon inflicts 60% slow for 1s
All items inflict 80% for 1s on impact when thrown
Flintlock & Sticky Crossbow inflict 90% slow for 1s
Raiden Coil inflicts 100% slow for 1.5s
Hit slow now stacks
Dodge rolling now removes all hit slow
Decreased Hand Cannon accuracy
Base spread increased to 5° (from 3°)
Max recoil increased to 29.9° (from 15°)
Reduced fuse & charge time for all relevant weapons
Banzai Bomb fuse set to 2s (prev. 2.5s)
Raiden Coil charge time set to 1s (prev. 1.5s)
Sticky Crossbow explosive bolt fuse set to 1s (prev. 1.5s)

Flare Gun max ammo reduced to 8 (from 12)

Raiden Coil max ammo reduced to 6 (from 9)
Sticky Crossbow max ammo reduced to 8 (from 16)
Increased size of most projectiles
All projectiles & thrown items now have a hitbox radius of 0.4m
(Blaster, Cleaver, Explosive Bolt, Katana was previously 0.2m)
(Patriot, Pump Shotgun was previously 0.25m)
(Super Shotgun was previously 0.27m)
(Flare, Flare Gun, Flintlock, Hand Cannon, Raiden Coil was previously 0.3m)
(Banzai Bomb was previously 0.35m)
(Buzzkill, Shuriken, Sticky Crossbow was already 0.4m)
Afterburn now has a max duration of 4s
Reloads will now auto-complete even when the weapon is switched away, provided that the first half of the reload was done while equipped
Affects Blitzkrieg, Boomstick, Breacher, Hand Cannon (irrelevant for single-shot weapons)

Changed
Reworked splash damage calculation which now uses the closest point on the player collider to determine damage (rather than the center)
Reworked modifier system for better stability and faster network performance
Updated healing particle system
The Danger Zone timer will now show one decimal

Removed static view spectator camera mode
Fences will now allow hitscan shots to pass through but not projectiles
Swapping items will now cancel eating

Improved decal shading quality

Fixed dodge roll collision distance when dodge rolling diagonally into a collider

Fixed sneaking icon lingering when switching to free spectate if the previous spectated player was sneaking
Fixed some obstacles not contributing to Fog of War
Fixed issue where the laser sight would occasionally disappear on projectile weapons
Fixed input issues with charge weapons on lower framerates
Fixed fire rate issues on high fire rate weapons when playing with high ping
Fixed decals being incorrectly applied on some items and projectiles

notes.title: Beta Branch Testing - New Map!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33198949/ba79447b02fd1a28ce7f8c79135fbcfba60f0c06.png
Oh boy, an update, kind of
Hey folks! We have a bit of an update for you. However, this is not actually an official update. As you all long we've been working hard at bringing new content to you folks. But before we push officially, we're opening up a Beta Branch to everyone who owns the game. (((ೕ( ･ㅂ･)و )))

Beta Branch Includes
Weapon Rebalancing
New Weapons
Reworked Dodge Rolling
New Map 

Just remember that this map and these weapons are still being tested. So we’re working out kinks in their balance, and working out the lighting on the map. Any bugs you might find definitely wave your arms around at us and we’ll get it written down and fixed up. We won't go too into detail, so you'll have to check it out for yourself! (ง ͠ ͠° ل͜ °)ง

How To Access The Beta Branch
Open Steam, right click on BANZAI ROYALE and selected PROPERTIES
Select the BETA tab at the top

notes.title: Small Fixes!
notes.content:
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/HideousRadiantGoat-size_restricted.gif

Change Log 0.1.9.1 °˖✧◝(⁰▿⁰)◜✧˖°
Hey folks! Just a small update here to make things a bit smoother. We've had a lot of people tell us they have a hard time knowing when ammo is out, so we got that fixed up!

As always, if anyone ever has any problems, ideas, or issues, just let us know and we'll do the best we can for you! So! Moving on!

Added
Added a crosshair animation when the current weapon is out of ammo
Added a HUD icon that shows when the player is sneaking

Changed
Updated default controller bindings
DPad Left now toggles minimap
DPad Right now toggles last equipped item
DPad Left now selects consumable
Left Stick Button now toggles sneak instead of minimap
B now only toggles melee/equipment
Camera Extend is now a toggle instead of hold
Controller bindings will be reset to default upon first launch
Improved dodge roll collision detection and physics
Will try to find the furthest dodge roll distance with a free spot to land
The corners of the big tree boxes can now be dodge rolled
Crosshair progress/ammo circle will now be hidden when out of ammo
Increased out of ammo SFX volume
Tweaked Katana, Cleaver and Banzai Bomb equip animations
Improved item throw synchronization

Fixed
All player character sound effects will now be force stopped upon death to fix the eternal screaming bug
Reworked how player modifier sound effects are played and stopped in order to fix the eternal screaming bug
Fixed players being able to step up onto objects with low height
Fixed grainy real-time shadows
Fixed reload animation on crosshair playing on some weapons when there’s no ammo left


Want to know what else we have coming? Join us on our Discord!
(❁´ω`❁) 
Remember to verify the integrity of your files!

notes.title: Controller Support Is Here!
notes.content:
Changelog 0.1.9.0 ヽ/❀o ل͜ o\ﾉ
It’s here! So it’s time for a nice ol’ update! First off, like last time, thank you all so much for being here with us while we do our best to expand both the game and our community. Everyone of you is absolutely fantastic and I’m so stoked for your support and patience. You’re all great and you should feel good about yourselves.

Moving on, time for the big stuff!

Partial Controller Support is here!
Controllers are now supported for in-game play (does not work with menu). So now you can kick our butts using one of the following
Xbox 360
Xbox One
PS4 .+:｡(ﾉ･ω･)ﾉﾞ
Wireless Switch Pro Controller should work (untested)
Unsupported controllers may work after rebinding the buttons

Rebindable Keys so you can do the stuff you want to do!
Go into the options menu to rebind your keys and controller buttons (looking at you Fulgur)

*✲ﾟ*｡✧٩(･ิᴗ･ิ๑)۶*✲ﾟ*｡✧

Additional Changes
Reworked dodge roll physics in order to prevent players from clipping, getting stuck or ending up in an unfortunate place
Out of ammo message will now instantly show when out of ammo instead of when attempting to fire
Lowered main menu announcer volume
Removed “How to play” since controller binding screen fills the same purpose
Tweaked main menu lighting

Fixes
Fixed dodge roll jitter on clients when activating just as the cooldown ends
Fixed spot in park alley where players could get stuck
Fixed spot behind grocery store where players could clip into the store
Fixed outside edge of railings being walkable
Improved projectile synchronization
Flintlock will no longer play reload sound when out of ammo

This Weeks Player Shoutout
Fulgur, SE Kiyo, Yurio & Koubokin! You folks are doing fantastic and are our top picks for players for the week! 

 ヾ(ﾟ∀ﾟ○)ﾂ三ヾ(●ﾟ∀ﾟ)ﾉ Don’t forget to update the integrity of your files!
Well thats it for this week folk! Want to know what else is coming up? Come visit us on Discord to hear about upcoming content or test the new map (oops did I say new map).
